protocol.objective: Integrated droplet-digital (D2) microfluidic platform for isolation and recovery of rare single cells and beads from processed droplets; applied to fluorescent bead recovery, low-input rare GFP HEK293 cell sorting, and rare specific-antibody-secreting hybridoma cell screening and recovery for antibody discovery

key_results.cell_recovery_D2_pct: >80 across all ratios and cell inputs

device.name: Droplet-Digital (D2) Microfluidic Device
layers: Layer i: Chromium electrodes patterned on 50x75 mm glass slides (Telic, Valencia, CA); S1811 positive resist; UV exposure 7 s at 38-50 mW/cm2; developed MF-321; etched CR-4; stripped AZ-300T
Layer ii: PDMS dielectric, ~7 um thick; 1:10 w/w curing agent:prepolymer spin-coated at 4500 rpm for 90 s; baked 90 C for 1 h
Layer iii: PDMS channel layer; SU-8 2075 on 100 mm Si wafer; two-layer master (100 um each); soft lithography; room-temperature cure >= 48 h to prevent shrinkage
channel_sections: Six pairs of arrest electrodes in sorting channel
Semicircular open-access collection outlet (3 mm biopsy punch, razor-excised semicircle)

electrodes.sorter_type: DMF binary sorter with patterned electrodes beneath channel
electrodes.advantage_over_DEP: DEP systems require 200-1200 V; D2 uses <140 Vrms, minimising electric-field-induced cell damage

inlets.oil_inlet: 2.5 mL gastight syringe, HFE7500 + 2% 008-fluoro-surfactant, Tygon 0.06-inch OD tubing
inlets.aqueous_inlet: 1 mL BD plastic syringe, cells/beads, Tygon 0.06-inch OD tubing
inlets.recovery_buffer_inlet: 500 uL gastight syringe, 1/32-inch OD PEEK tubing
inlets.withdrawal_waste: 2.5 mL gastight syringe, 1/32-inch OD PEEK tubing, set to -0.15 uL/s

outlet.access: Direct manual pipetting from collection channel to well plate

detection.fiber: 200 um core, 0.49 NA multimode optical fiber (Thorlabs)

device.surface_treatment: Aquapel, 1 min; dried; baked 85 C for 20 min

control_system.switches: Stacked optocoupler switch board + port expander
control_system.pump: Cetoni neMESYS low-pressure syringe pump system

reagents.surfactant: 008-fluoro-surfactant 5% wt in HFE7500 (RAN Biotechnologies), used at 2% w/v
reagents.density_gradient: OptiPrep iodixanol density gradient medium (Sigma-Aldrich); 16% for beads, 11% w/v for hybridoma/target cells, 80 uL added to 400 uL cell suspension for HEK experiments

bead_model.preparation: Washed 3x PBS; diluted to 1e6 beads/mL; 16% OptiPrep added

cell_media.hybridoma_culture: IMDM + 10% heat-inactivated FBS + mouse IL-6 1 ng/mL + 1% penicillin/streptomycin
cell_media.hybridoma_sort: IMDM (no phenol red) + 10% FBS + mouse IL-6 1 ng/mL (no antibiotics)
cell_media.target_cell_sort: IMDM (no phenol red) + 10% FBS + IL-6 1 ng/mL + Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibody 2.5 ug/mL (no antibiotics)
cell_media.conditioned_media_HEK: 30% spent eGFP HEK supernatant (0.22 um filtered) + 70% fresh DMEM + 10% FBS + 1% P/S; used first 24 h post-sort

AlexaFluor488_AntiMouse.labels: secondary antibody for specific mAb binding detection

SYTOX_Blue.labels: dead cells (blue stain); used for post-sort viability assay

recovery_buffers.beads: PBS (100 uL pre-loaded per well + 3 uL on-chip recovery buffer)
recovery_buffers.HEK293: DMEM (100 uL pre-loaded per well + 3 uL on-chip recovery buffer)
recovery_buffers.hybridoma: IMDM + 10% FBS + 1 ng/mL IL-6 + 1% P/S (100 uL pre-loaded + 3 uL on-chip recovery buffer)

protocols.name: Fluorescent bead recovery (pooled and single)
protocols.purpose: Benchmark D2 recovery against conventional tubing method; establish baseline recovery rate and reproducibility for bead model

steps.name: Device priming and baseline flow setup
steps.notes: Oil injected first to prime all channels. Waste syringe set to -0.15 uL/s so all droplets default to waste channel before sorting is triggered.

steps.name: Bead suspension preparation
steps.notes: Beads washed 3x PBS; OptiPrep prevents clumping/sedimentation during chip operation.

steps.name: Bead encapsulation in ~1 nL droplets
steps.operation: flow-focusing encapsulation (abstracted as mix in BioScript)
steps.notes: Poisson-based encapsulation. Sorting threshold 7e3-2e4 photon counts selects single-bead droplets.

steps.name: Fiber-optic PMT detection and FADS sorting
steps.notes: Peaks above lower bound and below upper bound (multi-bead exclusion) trigger electrode actuation at sorting junction.

pass.action: generate recovery buffer; merge; pipette to well

steps.name: On-demand droplet collection and recovery
steps.operation: dispense recovery buffer + DMF electrode merge + manual pipette
steps.notes: Sorted 1 nL droplet travels to collection outlet after 7 s delay (arrested by 6 electrode pairs). 3x electrode actuation merges droplet with 3 uL PBS buffer. P20 pipette (5 uL) transfers merged contents to individual well.

pooled_recovery.significance: ns (no significant difference between D2 and tubing at each n)
pooled_recovery.notes: D2 fivefold reduction in SD at 50 beads vs tubing. Tubing arc traps droplets; HFE oil heavier than aqueous phase causes droplets to remain at top of tubing.

single_recovery.notes: Single recovery = 1 droplet per well. Tubing fails at single recovery because insufficient flow rate to displace individual droplets through arc; droplets trapped at PDMS-tubing interface (wall thickness > droplet diameter <100 um).

protocols.name: Low-input rare single GFP HEK293 cell recovery and viability
protocols.purpose: Demonstrate D2 recovery of rare target cells at biologically relevant low ratios; validate post-sort viability and proliferation over 7 days

steps.name: Cell culture and preparation
steps.culture_conditions: DMEM + 10% heat-inactivated FBS + 1% P/S; 37 C, 5% CO2; passage every 2 days at 80% confluency
steps.trypsinization: 2 mL trypsin, 5 min 37 C; quench 8 mL DMEM + 10% FBS; centrifuge 1000 rpm 5 min; resuspend PBS
steps.optiprep_addition: 80 uL OptiPrep added to 400 uL cell suspension; vortex gently
steps.notes: Low-volume inputs mimic rare cell scenarios. 1:1000 ratio models 0.1% target frequency, comparable to antigen-specific B cell rarity.

pass.action: generate DMEM recovery buffer; merge; pipette to well

steps.name: Single cell recovery into 96-well plate
steps.operation: dispense recovery buffer + DMF electrode merge + manual pipette
steps.notes: One cell per well. Plate transferred to incubator immediately after experiment.

steps.name: Post-sort cell culture: conditioned media phase
steps.conditioned_media_composition: 30% spent eGFP HEK supernatant (0.22 um filtered) + 70% fresh DMEM + 10% FBS + 1% P/S
steps.notes: Conditioned media supports single-cell survival in first 24 h post-sort.

steps.name: 7-day clonal expansion
steps.imaging: EVOS M5000; bright-field and GFP fluorescence every 24 h
steps.notes: Cells exhibit spreading by day 1 (positive viability indicator). GFP fluorescence confirms identity. Proliferation confirmed over 7 days.

results.recovery_rate_D2_pct: >80 for all conditions (1e4 and 1e5 cells; 1:400 and 1:1000 ratios)
results.proliferation: Confirmed over 7 days with spreading at day 1

protocols.name: Rare specific-antibody-secreting hybridoma cell screening and recovery
protocols.purpose: Antibody discovery application: sort and recover specific-mAb-secreting hybridoma cells co-encapsulated with target antigen-expressing cells at rare biological ratios

steps.name: Hybridoma cell mixture preparation

cell_lines.specific_Ab_producer: Hybridoma secreting mAbs that bind surface antigen of target cells; stained with calcein-AM red-orange

steps.rationale: Models natural frequency of antigen-specific B cells (0.1-2% of isolated B cells)
steps.buffer: IMDM (no phenol red) + 10% FBS + 1 ng/mL IL-6 (no antibiotics)
steps.prewash: 3x with neat IMDM to remove FBS before experiment

steps.name: Target cell preparation
steps.dissociation: Non-enzymatic cell dissociation solution (1x, pre-warmed 37 C) to preserve surface antigen expression
steps.buffer: IMDM (no phenol red) + 10% FBS + 1 ng/mL IL-6
steps.secondary_antibody: Alexa Fluor 488 goat anti-mouse IgG (H+L), 2.5 ug/mL
steps.notes: Secondary antibody pre-added to target cell suspension; accumulates on cell surface only if specific primary mAb is present after co-incubation.

steps.name: Co-encapsulation (separate co-encapsulation chip)
steps.operation: flow-focusing co-encapsulation (abstracted as mix in BioScript)
steps.notes: Double-cell droplets contain one hybridoma cell + one target cell. Poisson occupancy.

steps.name: Off-chip droplet incubation
steps.collection: Withdrawal syringe (BD 1 mL plastic) collects droplets
steps.mechanism: Specific mAbs secreted by hybridoma cells bind to target cell surface antigen. Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibodies bind primary mAbs, generating high-intensity green fluorescence (>18,000 counts) exclusively in specific-Ab + target cell doublet droplets.

steps.name: Re-injection into D2 sorting chip and antibody-binding sort

pass.action: generate IMDM recovery buffer; merge; pipette to well

steps.name: Single hybridoma-target cell pair recovery into 96-well plate
steps.operation: dispense recovery buffer + DMF electrode merge + manual pipette
steps.verification: Specific-Ab hybridoma confirmed by calcein-AM red co-localisation; target cell by CellTrace Blue; binding by Alexa Fluor 488 green
steps.notes: Well plate moved to incubator immediately post-experiment.

results.advantage: On-demand selective collection based on phenotypic fluorescence readout significantly reduces false positives and minimises stochastic sample loss vs passive flow valve mechanisms (e.g. Cyto-Mine)

conversions.1440m: 24 h conditioned media incubation (86400 s in IR)
conversions.8640m: 6-day remaining expansion after 24 h (518400 s in IR)

compiler_notes: drain normalised to dispose in IR -- expected compiler behaviour, confirmed by reference files
alexaFluor4881[0] in IR is variable alexaFluor488 + instance suffix 1 -- not a stale reference (regex parsing artifact)
All variable instances are 1 throughout IR -- no stale or phantom variables
undefined-before-use flags on beadDroplets/beadSignal in branch blocks are text-order artifacts; IR is not in execution order; both variables are defined in main before any branch target executes
wellEnvironment (DMEM_Complete dispense in BB7) replaces previously disposed mergedCellDrop -- bug fixed in v2
BioScript has no loop construct; one representative sort cycle per protocol is encoded, consistent with both reference files

key_tubing_failure_modes: Tubing arc creates static zone where droplets accumulate
HFE oil heavier than aqueous droplets; droplets float to top of arc
PDMS-tubing wall thickness > droplet diameter (<100 um); droplets trapped at junction
Droplet coalescence and cross-talk when droplets contact each other in tubing
key_D2_advantages: No tubing required at collection site
Droplets isolated/parked individually; no fusion or diffusive exchange
Direct pipetting access via open semicircular outlet
5-fold reduction in SD at 50 bead events

Cyto_Mine.limitation: Closed proprietary system; limited flexibility; passive flow valve mechanism susceptible to stochastic loss
